summary: Iteration 23 - Role-specific audit rules tested. Backend pytest 25/25 PASS covering (a) sgsst_manager PUT /api/audits/{id}/checklist/{itemId} -> 403, PUT /api/findings/{id} -> 403, POST /api/findings -> 403, PUT /api/audits/{id} -> 403; (b) sgsst_manager CRUD on /api/action-plans works (POST/PUT/follow-up all 200); (c) PDF gating: sgsst_manager 403 on opening/closing/report PDFs for an open (planned) audit and 200 for a closed audit, admin+auditor always 200 on both states; (d) auditor CAN PUT audit, generate checklist, PUT checklist item, and POST findings/generate-from-checklist; (e) AI narrative assist 200 + non-empty result for types opening_narrative/closing_narrative/report_narrative (gpt-5.2); (f) PUT /api/audits/{id}/ai-redaction persists narrative_opening/closing/report and GET /api/audits/{id} returns them; (g) Generated opening-minutes PDF size grows materially (>300 bytes) when narrative_opening is filled vs empty using non-repetitive random text, proving injection; (h) /rbac/permissions flags exactly match spec for admin, sgsst_manager (can_edit_audit_items=False, can_edit_action_plans=True, can_use_ai_narrative=False, can_view_documents/hazards/training/reports/implementation=True) and auditor (all three audit flags True, can_report_incidents=False, can_view_documents/hazards/training/reports/implementation=False, can_view_audits=True). Frontend Playwright revealed TWO bugs: (1) auditor sidebar shows 'Incidentes' (in addition to Dashboard + Auditorias) - spec requires ONLY Dashboard + Auditorias; backend permission flag can_report_incidents=False for auditor is correct, so Layout.js 'Incidentes' nav item is NOT gated by that flag; (2) sgsst_manager AuditList still renders 'Acta Apertura' and 'Acta Cierre' buttons on at least some open (Programada) audit rows (first row TEST_IT24_open_f3344d) - spec requires these to be hidden entirely for mgr on non-closed audits, showing only 'Descargas disponibles al cerrar' instead. MGR sidebar correctly shows the 8 expected modules. MGR Consolidado empty state ('Selecciona una auditoria primero') blocks verifying the badge without audit selection.

ui_bugs.issue: Auditor sees 'Incidentes' in sidebar - should only show Dashboard + Auditorias per spec. Backend /rbac/permissions returns can_report_incidents=false for auditor (confirmed), so the nav filter for Incidentes is either missing or not wired to can_report_incidents.

Acta Apertura / Acta Cierre buttons still visible on open (Programada) audit rows for Responsable SST. Per spec they must be hidden until audit.status in ['closed','reviewed'] (or replaced with the 'Descargas disponibles al cerrar' badge). Inconsistent: some rows hide them but at least the first Programada row shows both buttons.

Two frontend gating bugs to re-verify after main agent fix: (1) Layout.js must hide 'Incidentes' for auditor (gate by perms.can_report_incidents), (2) Audits.js AuditList must hide 'Acta Apertura'/'Acta Cierre' buttons for sgsst_manager unless audit.status in ['closed','reviewed']. rca_of_the_issue: Backend layer correctly enforces role/status gating via require_role() and _require_pdf_download_access(). Frontend is missing two filters that should mirror the backend permission contract: Layout.js does not gate Incidentes by can_report_incidents (auditor flag is false, yet nav still rendered - likely the Incidentes entry has no can_view_* predicate attached, unlike Documentos/Matriz IPER/etc), and Audits.js AuditList row still renders the Acta buttons regardless of canEditAuditItems/audit.status combo for sgsst_manager. Both are pure UI filter gaps (backend returns correct flags).
